calmChat.toggleOn: Calm Chat is on: repeated messages are grouped and new lines slowed down
calmChat.toggleOff: Calm Chat is off: every line is shown
calmChat.settings.title: Calm Chat
calmChat.settings.intro: Groups repeated messages and limits how many new lines appear each second. Mentions of you, the broadcaster and moderators are always shown. Saved on this device.
calmChat.settings.rateValue: {count, plural, one {# line a second} other {# lines a second}}
calmChat.keys.title: Keyboard
calmChat.digest: {messages, plural, one {# new message} other {# new messages}}{waves, plural, =0 {} one {, # wave ({top})} other {, # waves ({top})}}{mentions, plural, =0 {} one {, # mention of you} other {, # mentions of you}}{hidden, plural, =0 {} one {. # line not shown} other {. # lines not shown}}
calmChat.wave.summary: {body}: repeated {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} by {senders, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
blocks.confirmBody: Their messages are hidden from you in chat and in chat replay. They are not told. You can unblock them in Settings, Privacy.
blocks.failed: Could not block this person. Try again.
blocks.limit: You have blocked as many people as you can. Unblock someone first.
blocks.title: Blocked users
blocks.intro: People you block are hidden from you in chat and chat replay. They are not told, and it does not change what anyone else sees.
blocks.emptyHint: To block someone, open the menu beside one of their chat messages.
blocks.loadFailed: Could not load the people you blocked.
